title: "Anna Butler - Aunt Louisa’s Travels"
book_id: 242
---

## Publication Information

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (July 1852- June 1854).

**Notes:** This is a series in which Aunt Louisa describes her journey to Switzerland to her nephew Arthur and her nieces Caroline and Grace. (Butler's brother the Rev. William Butler had a son Arthur and a daughter Grace, and a sister-in-law, Louisa Barnett.)
